_comment: Location knowledge, one entry per tool. This is DATA — a new tool is a new entry, not a code change. Resolution order per tool: env_root, then settings key, then default_roots (first hit wins). 'documented: false' means the vendor publishes no format and the reader is best-effort; parsing gaps are attributable to the source, not to missing data.

tools._exclude_note: MEMORY.md is an index of the topic files, not a memory itself. Reading it would duplicate every record.

tools._section_note: save_memory appends agent-written facts under this heading INSIDE the same file a person hand-writes. Split the file at the heading; never tag it whole.
tools._patch_note: Experimental auto-memory writes review candidates as unified diffs awaiting human approval. Read and set aside — an unreviewed candidate is not a memory.

tools._documented_note: The memories feature is experimental and off by default; OpenAI publishes no format. Paths reflect third-party observation. Version this entry against what is actually seen, not against a spec.

tools._note: No agent-written memory exists for this tool. Human instructions only.

tools._authorship_note: One directory holds BOTH kinds. Only global_rules.md is the person's; everything else in memories/ is the model's. Tagging the directory as one thing is wrong half the time.

tools._note: The tool-agnostic user-level instructions file a dozen tools now read in common. One entry covers most of the long tail at zero per-tool cost.
For anyone whose tool keeps memory server-side or UI-only. Converts 'your tool is unsupported' into a manual option rather than a dead end.

unreachable.reason: Agent memories are server-side with no disclosed path. User rules are UI-only with no filesystem location. Project rules (.cursor/rules/) are committed and arrive via the source-control connector.
unreachable.action: Report as unsupported. Do not reverse-engineer the local chat store.
